copy.curiosityHook: What devastating price will each ruler pay when their unchecked desires and surreal obsessions spiral out of control?
copy.description: In Matteo Garrone's dark fairy tale, three neighboring kingdoms unravel through extreme obsessions: a desperate queen risks all for a child, a king chases a hidden voice, and another neglects his daughter for a flea.
copy.vibeSummary: Deliberate, lavish, and deeply unsettling, this dark fantasy demands engaged, solitary viewing.
copy.whyWatch: Blending grotesque horror with baroque fantasy, this rich anthology offers an atmospheric, slow-burning dive into the unsettling costs of royal desire and dark folklore.
